transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Okay, welcome back everyone. It's the twenty-third. This is the evaluation meeting, so we look at the prototype against the criteria and then plan the final presentation.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Great, I brought the questionnaires.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: And I've got the prototype here. It's yellow!

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Oh nice. Can I hold it?

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Sure, here. Careful, the scroll wheel is a bit sticky.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Yeah, I feel it. It catches.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: That's the, um, the rubber ring rubbing the casing. I'll try to fix that, but I need to see if the tolerances allow it.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Okay. So go through the criteria. Hannah, you've got the numbers from the questionnaire.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Yeah. So we asked the, um, twelve people in the lab. Looks, seven out of seven on the scale. Sorry, the average was six point five.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Wow.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Ease of use, five point eight. The scroll wheel scored really well.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: See, intuitive.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Yeah, nobody asked what it was. Which is, you know, I was worried.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Good. And the fancy factor?

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Six. Which is good. People liked the colour a lot.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Even the older people?

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Even them. Well, except one guy who said it looks like a toy.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Ha, there's always one.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Right. And cost. Priya?

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: So the costs, um, we're at eleven ninety per unit. Under the twelve fifty. Which is a relief.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: That's excellent. Would you be able to send me the breakdown in writing? For the presentation.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Yes, I'll email the full cost breakdown to you tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Tomorrow, the twenty-fourth. Great.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: For the usability numbers, I'm happy to add them to the slides. Like the charts from the lab, the error counts, the time to change a channel.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: That would be great, Leo. When can you do that?

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Wednesday. I'll have the usability results in the deck by Wednesday.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Wednesday the twenty-fifth. Perfect.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: So are we going with this? I mean the whole remote as is?

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: I think so, yes. Anybody against? The yellow rubber one with the scroll wheel goes to the final presentation.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: No, I think it's good.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Yeah, go.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Yes.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Then that's decided. We go with it.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: What about the scroll wheel being sticky?

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: I'll try to fix it, like I said. Worst case we say in the presentation it's a prototype issue.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Okay. Priya will have a look. No date, it's a prototype thing.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Right.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Should we do one more round of testing? Like after the fix?

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Maybe. I don't know if we have the time.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: We don't. Skip it.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Okay, fine.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: So for the final presentation. I'll prepare the slides, the main deck, and I'll get the draft done by Friday.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: The twenty-seventh?

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: The twenty-seventh, yes.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Can I do the marketing slide?

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Oh, please. Actually, Hannah, send me that, um, a page, whatever you've got, and I'll put it in.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Okay. I'll, uh, I'll write something up.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Cool.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Oh and, should we rehearse? Like, all together before the actual one? I think we should rehearse. Maybe Thursday.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Sure, why not.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Let's see how it goes. If there's time. I'm not putting it in the calendar yet.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: It would help though.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Yeah, yeah, I know.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: And the room. For the presentation. Who's booking the room? Because last time it was a mess.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Hm. Who is going to book the meeting room for the presentation?

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: I'm out Thursday and Friday.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: I don't have the access, I'm external.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: I can't either.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Okay. Nobody's got it for now.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: By the way, after the launch we could, you know, do a follow-up session with the marketing team and see how it sells.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Yeah, that would be nice. Not for now though.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: If it sells well we could do a, um, a version with the backlight.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: If it sells well we'd have a budget for anything.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Ha.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Right, I think that's all. Thank you, everybody. It's been a pleasure.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Same here.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Bye all!

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Bye.
